page.title: Kith — Remember the people you want to stay close to
page.description: A private relationship-memory app for iPhone.

hero.title: Remember the people you want to stay close to.
hero.lede: A place for how you met, what matters now, and the dated moments you do not want to forget, without turning care into a CRM.
hero.note: Internal TestFlight only. No public invite or App Store listing.

screen.alt: Kith on iPhone showing a warm constellation of people sized by chosen closeness

sections.title: See closeness the way *you chose it.*
sections.lede: Every person becomes a warm lantern. Its size comes only from the 1–5 closeness you set: not recency, message volume, or an algorithm.

screen.alt: Kith home screen enlarged: lanterns for Amma, Arjun, Priya, Maya, Dev and Nora, each sized by chosen closeness

caption.text: A searchable list view stays one tap away, for speed and VoiceOver.

sections.title: Keep the context that makes care specific.
sections.lede: A person holds their circle, birthday, how you met, standing notes, and a chronological log of notes, hangouts, calls, gifts and things to remember.

screen.alt: Kith person page for Maya Rao with how you met, keep in mind, birthday and a dated log

caption.text: “Hates being late. Always orders the extra chai.” The small facts, kept where you will find them.

sections.title: Start with one real person, not an import.
sections.lede: A name, their circle and closeness, and one thing worth remembering. That first moment stays with them, ready when you come back.

screen.alt: Kith first-run flow asking for one real person and a chosen closeness

sections.title: The iPhone stays *the working copy.*
sections.lede: Edits save on your iPhone first, so Kith works offline. An optional Significant Hobbies account syncs through the private Hub; local use never needs it.

rows.title: iPhone
rows.body: The full document. Adding people, closeness, search and notes all work here.

rows.title: iCloud
rows.body: A private CloudKit mirror stays on during the sync transition.

rows.title: Hub
rows.body: Structured person fields and dated notes, only if you connect an account.

rows.title: This site
rows.body: Counts visits and named actions. Email updates only after you opt in.

aside.title: Kith may fit if
aside.body: you want to keep the small facts and dated moments that help you be more thoughtful with family, close friends, and the other people who matter.

aside.title: It is not
aside.body: a contact book, social network, sales pipeline, messaging app, attention score, or reminder service. Kith never browses your address book or decides who deserves care.

closing.title:
Remember what mattered.
*Show up with the context.*
closing.note: Internal TestFlight only. No public invite or App Store listing.

footer.summary: A private, device-first iPhone app for remembering the people you keep close. Internal TestFlight only.
